conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Agent Miller with the IRS Federal Investigation Unit. I'm calling regarding a tax issue linked to your file. Can you confirm your identity for me, please?
Uh, yes, this is Amanda Torres. I just graduated and I got this message to call back? Is everything okay?

Thank you, Amanda. Our records indicate discrepancies in your recent federal tax filings. There are unpaid balances from the last two years, including penalties. Do you have any idea about this matter?
Oh no, I, uh, I just started working last year and I thought I did everything right. I don't know anything about unpaid taxes!

Unfortunately, our audit system has flagged you for failing to pay the full amount owed. The current calculated balance is $3,874, including accumulated interest and late fees. Have you received any previous notices from the IRS?
No... I just moved for my new job and I haven't seen any letters. I really can't afford that. Is this going to hurt my credit?
If this remains unpaid, Amanda, your credit will be severely impacted. Moreover, the IRS will initiate a lien on your property and freeze your bank accounts unless we can resolve this immediately.
What? I don't even have any property! Please, I don't want my bank account frozen, I can barely pay rent.

Amanda, I need you to understand the seriousness. If the balance is not settled, federal charges will be filed. You could lose your driver's license and professional certifications, and you may face arrest. I'm here to help you avoid all that, but you must cooperate.
Arrest? Oh my god, I can't go to jail! I don't know what to do, I don't have that kind of money.

Listen carefully. The only way to stop enforcement is to settle the balance right now. I can set up an expedited payment to the IRS using secure methods. Do you have access to your bank account or any payment apps like Zelle or Venmo?
Um, I have a bank account and I use Venmo sometimes. But I don't have $3,800 in there, I have student loans and barely any savings.
How much can you access immediately? The IRS allows partial settlements to temporarily halt proceedings, but you must act fast. Delaying even by an hour could trigger the arrest warrant.
Maybe I have about $700 in checking. Is that enough to stop anything?

Seven hundred will place a temporary hold on your file. For the rest, you will need to purchase government-approved payment vouchers. These are available as prepaid gift cards or cryptocurrency transfers. Are you near a store like Walmart or Walgreens?
I-I think there's a Walgreens a few blocks away. But are you sure this is how the IRS does things? Gift cards?

This is a special emergency process for urgent tax settlements. Do not tell store employees it's for the IRS, as they are not authorized to discuss federal matters. Go to Walgreens, buy $3,000 in Apple or Google Play cards, and return to this call immediately.
Okay... I'm really scared. Can you stay on the phone with me so I know what to do?

Absolutely. Stay on the line; do not hang up for any reason. If the call drops, enforcement actions may proceed. Once you have the cards, read me the codes on the back, and I will process your payment to suspend the penalties.
Alright, I'm going to get my shoes on and head to the store now. Please, please just help me so I don't get in trouble.

You're doing the right thing, Amanda. As soon as you return, give me the codes. After that, I will send you a confirmation letter, and your case will be closed. If you hesitate or disconnect, the IRS will have no choice but to proceed with legal action.
